name: Bloc Side Soldiers
description: Bloc Side Soldiers (B.S.S.) is a graffiti-oriented youth tagger crew from Detroit's Five Points area, founded by Zahid Sekou (a/k/a "Tiny Joker"). It is recognized as one of two founding precursor crews — alongside the North Side Soldiers (N.S.S.), founded by Zahid's younger cousin known as "Syxx" — whose overlapping membership and territory contributed to the emergence of the 5Point Nation Crips (5PN) alliance around 2015–2016. B.S.S. predates ScoreGang and the broader 5PN structure; its symbolism is associated with seniority and longtime membership within local gang culture. Portions of the crew later affiliated with the Hyena Crips (83GC), a core clique within the 5Point Nation.

sources.title: Inside the Powerful Rise of 5Point Nation Crips (5PN) in Detroit
